title: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked | TechCrunch
summary: Citibank, the third largest commercial bank in the United States, changed its terms of service this week, telling customers who use third-party AI tools for personal finance that anything that goes wrong is their problem — even if they get hacked.
